✅ stripeController.js (lines 816-821): verify-session endpoint returns chargedCurrency and chargedAmount from Stripe session

context_for_next_testing_agent: Currency conversion feature is fully implemented and tested. The key logic is: 1) Backend returns chargedCurrency and chargedAmount from Stripe session, 2) Frontend calculates conversionRatio = chargedAmount / usdTotal, 3) All line items are multiplied by this ratio before display. This ensures numbers add up correctly when user pays in local currency (e.g., CAD) but prices are stored in USD.
